opener.seg: [Inclosure in No. 665.—Translation from the Monitor Republicano, of July 15, 1883.]

div.p: The following persons have been appointed by the secretary of hacienda, a committee to propose a proper method for the settlement and conversion of the debt:

The President haying been authorized by law of the 14th June last past, to settle and convert the national debt, considers that the public interests demand the immediate exercise of this authority, and at the same time, desiring the co-operation of competent persons to facilitate a solution of the difficulties of the question, suggesting intelligent methods to accomplish the settlement and conversion of the debt in strict conformity with the terms of the act of Congress.

Governed by these motives, the President of the Republic has determined to appoint a consulting committee (junta consultiva), charged with the duty of suggesting to this department such methods as they may consider effective to bring to a good end the operation of settling and converting the debt, as well as to advise upon such matters as may be presented to them upon the subject in hand.

The President has seen fit to appoint you a member of said committee (junta) in connection with Messieurs* * * believing that you will not decline to give your valuable co-operation in the work to which I have referred.

1 have the honor to notify you of your appointment, informing you that the committee will elect from its own body its president, and that this department will appoint a secretary to said committee, of which you will be informed in due season.

postscript.p: To Messrs. Manuel Dublan, Pedro Escudero y Echanove, Antonio Carvajal, Francisco Bulues, Gumesindo Enriquez.
